frame_boundary_reference: OMB July 2023; preserve source-native geographic qualifications
company_source_selection: Retained 2025 annual filing when available; otherwise retained official supplemental route
source_screen_scope: One company-level source attempt; not a separate audit of every company-MSA-year cell
industry_scope: All industries; same initial source rule and broad-sector collection
new_location_date_basis: Source fiscal period annotation with exact filing date retained in raw archive; no independent occupancy-date claim
geography_rule: Exact state/locality Census place or county-subdivision point matched to 2023 CBSA polygons; document aliases; unresolved remains unassigned
count_rule: Distinct company IDs within MSA, source year and function; do not sum functional roles or interpret city clusters as physical sites
office_negative_rule: No absence-capable audit completed; all unobserved office presences remain unknown
regional_sources_reused: Frozen study economic features and source registry
qcew_suppression_rule: Keep N-suppressed employment/wages/LQs null; retain disclosed establishment counts with flags
payload_citation_policy: Source URLs and detailed evidence only in raw_archive; analytical tables contain evidence IDs
predictor_policy: Existing 31 predictors preserved; additional metrics descriptive until a limited feature set is specified
further_collection_needed: Common-period directory/site review across industries; date/locality resolution and coverage validation before office ranking or presence models
